geometry.region_extra: The stitch row follows the full cuff perimeter including the rounded closure corner, turning that corner smoothly at a constant distance from the edge. Exactly ONE mother-of-pearl button, sewn flat through its holes.

offset = roughly one and a quarter stitch-lengths of the stitch itself
row perfectly parallel to the edge along its whole run

self-coloured thread, still legible via indentation and raking light
comparative_anchor: Second rung: the gap must read about THREE TIMES wider than the 0.1 cm version, yet clearly narrower than the 0.5 cm version (a full half-button) and narrower still than 0.6 cm.
